proposition: An issuer that re-evaluates every load-bearing fact in the same locked step as issuance (a) never issues a permit after a standing-defeating change has been accepted, and (b) still issues permits whose changes are not load-bearing, without blocking unrelated permits.

falsifier.race_test: A run is a violation if a withdrawal was accepted before issuance was recorded. An issuer FAILS if it has more than 0 violations in 1000 runs.
falsifier.paired_test: An issuer FAILS if any Case A permit is ISSUED, or any Case B, control or unrelated permit is HELD.
